title: Breach of Privacy in New TOS Update
text: Journals are supposed to be private. Currently this one is, but on December 20th the Terms of Service are instead going to require accounts on this app and will store all of your journal data in google servers. It’s even specified that people of interest can access your data and the update suggests it’ll be used to build a digital profile on you for advertisers when pairing up with data brokers like Meta. There is absolutely no point in moving the app off of device storage and into the cloud other than data harvesting, especially considering it appears they’re going to force data limits on us. As great as this app is, I think it’s time to let go and find an app that tailors towards the consumers and not towards big corporations.

title: Ads are ruining it
text: I used to tolerate the ads to save my journals because I genuinely enjoy this app, and I don’t mind purposefully watching ads for clovers to buy cute themes. But the new banners at the top and bottom are distracting, intrusive, and take away from user experience. I’d rather watch a longer ad to save my journal than see these ugly random ad banners honestly. Please consider removing these, I’d hate to leave the app over this but it’s hard to ignore

title: Ad Banner??
text: I loved this app, but the ads are becoming unbearable. I watch the daily ads just about every day in order to get clovers for new themes. I’ve noticed they’ve gotten way longer these past few months and now require me to be interactive with them to finally close out of them and earn my reward. Whatever, I’ve dealt with it because it allows me to collect the themes. But now, the newest addition is that there’s a banner at the bottom of the screen with an ad at all times. Now the ads are even ruining the cutesy look of my monthly themes that I have to sit through ads to buy in the first place. If this continues I may be transitioning to a new day tracking app, which sucks because I’ve been a huge fan and daily user of this app for 2+ years.

title: Used to be so much better
text: Used this app for almost 5 years and I loved it but it’s gotten to be way too much. Ads used to be skippable after 5 seconds but now I have to sit through at least 15 seconds, I can’t use things I used to be able to without paying, and I feel like it’s lost a lot of its “simple” feel. I don’t use dailybean anymore and I ended up going back to a paper journal.

title: Loading Time 👎
text: Great app but if you want to open it you will have to wait about 5 full minutes. It often gets stuck in this loading phase. I’m trying to jot notes down quickly. It’s hard enough to take time away from my day to Journal. Let alone to wait for an app to open this long and lose the thought. Figure this out, Dailybean.

title: Concerning Ads
text: This app is cute and I was looking forward to using it. But after my first log, I feel a little uneasy. I saw an AI propaganda ad funded by the Israeli Government Advertising Agency. It was through Google, that’s how I was able to check. I’m sure you can understand the multitude of reasons why this is concerning. One, it’s BLATANT propaganda related to an ongoing genocide. Second, what is it doing on a journaling app? I understand that the devs might not have power over the specific ads that get played, but this needs to be addressed somehow. AI propaganda that tries to rationalize the annihilation of innocent people should have no place anywhere, let alone on a cutesy mood tracking app.
